title: Raise shared_buffers and align planner cache costs to cut GetUserTweets terminal occupancy
configuration_cause: shared_buffers=16384 (128MB) is far below the 2TB host memory and the low_buffer_hit_ratio alert is active; random_page_cost=4.0 and effective_io_concurrency=1 make the planner overprice cached index lookups on the dominant GetUserTweets point-read path, so physical DataFileRead waits (35 samples) inflate per-transaction latency and terminal occupancy.
mechanism: GetUserTweets is 89% of terminal capacity at p50=196us with DataFileRead and BufferIO waits present. Enlarging shared_buffers to 32768 (256MB) retains the hot tweets/user index pages; raising effective_cache_size to 786432 tells the planner most reads are cached; raising effective_io_concurrency to 8 enables prefetch of index/bitmap pages; lowering random_page_cost to 2.0 and seq_page_cost to 0.8 keeps index-scan preference while removing the artificial penalty on cached random reads. Together these reduce physical reads per GetUserTweets, lowering its mean latency and freeing terminal capacity for more completed transactions.
query_effect: Cached index scans on tweets/user lookups avoid DataFileRead; planner keeps Index Scan (already observed) but with lower estimated random cost, favoring index paths over seq scans for GetUserTweets.
expected_tps_effect: Increase successful_transaction_tps above 20596 by reducing GetUserTweets terminal occupancy.
expected_latency_effect: Decrease GetUserTweets mean and p95 latency; overall p95 modestly lower.

predictions.rationale: Fewer physical reads per point lookup lowers mean service time.
Larger cache and prefetch reduce IO wait backends.
Lower terminal occupancy per GetUserTweets yields more completions.

alternatives.statement: If latency is dominated by WALSync rather than buffer reads, the buffer bundle will not move GetUserTweets and WAL commit-path tuning is the real lever.
If the working set already fits, only the planner cost changes matter and shared_buffers increase yields no additional gain.

why_exceeds_incumbent: Incumbent leaves the active low_buffer_hit_ratio alert unaddressed with 128MB shared_buffers on a 2TB host; the coherent cache-capacity bundle directly targets the dominant GetUserTweets terminal occupancy.

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Double from 128MB to 256MB, well within safe [8192,65536]; conservative first step given 2TB host memory.
1.5x from 4GB to 6GB, inside [131072,1048576]; signals larger cache to planner.
Raise from 1 to 8 within [0,256] to enable modest prefetch without oversubscribing.
Halve to 2.0 within [1.0,6.0]; cached random reads cheaper than default 4.0.
Lower to 0.8 within [0.5,2.0] to keep index-vs-seq ratio favorable after random_page_cost drop.
knob_changes.mechanism_role: I/O cost scale paired with random_page_cost

edges.relation: frees terminal capacity for more completions

cross_domain_requirements: WAL commit-path tuning is memory_storage scope; not executed here.
